semantic_summary: Methane leakage, landfill-gas and stack-monitoring methods remain measurement-method or permit evidence until actual site-specific values, units, period, uncertainty and geometry are present.
UK ETS factors, MRR guidance and waste-incineration MRV rules are accounting/reporting inputs rather than emissions observations.
CEMS, MCERTS, OMA and sampling QA prove monitoring quality controls, not the emission quantity itself.
Permit applications, BAT/BAT-AEL, risk assessments, dispersion models and consultations remain regulatory/model evidence and cannot be promoted to measured parcel GHG.
Carbon-capture readiness, BAT and consultation evidence do not establish captured, stored, avoided or emitted CO2 without explicit compatible quantities.
No browser acceptance, parcel binding, measured parcel values, database writes, migrations or deployments were executed.
